notes.title: Changing Publishers
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36775548/c8f59e09a82188a57ec22930a6ddf665f2c90978.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36775548/f02661b9ee2943cad843662171b04ffae8bf128d.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Greetings to the awesome players of Crash The Game,
[/h3]
Crash The Game is now officially owned by SilverDam™.
As you all know, when the developers of a game change to new ones the game loses its fun and becomes different in a negative way. However, that is not going to happen to Crash The Game. This game will remain the same from now on. No further updates at all.

Thanks to all of you for supporting the previous developers of this game.

Best regards,
SilverDam™ Development Team

So todays update compeltly revamps Pong Survival which is literally crackhead 2. Once its fully finished the name will change from pong surviver to CRACKHEAD TOO, Too instead of 2 :)
You can see by the picture its gone really vibrant and colourful. Theres alot of new content in the pong survivor. I really hope you enjoy the change. 1 last thing , the pong survival score board has been reset


thanks for reading!
